title: Polar animals
examples: What do polar bears eat in the cold?
How do penguins survive the cold water?

explain.say: Today you will learn about polar animals. They live in very cold places.
Polar bears live in the Arctic, in the far north. They have thick fat under their skin.
Many penguins live in Antarctica, near the South Pole. Penguins swim very well, but they cannot fly.
Seals have short fur and a thick layer of fat. They live near icy water.

items: Fur and fat: keep it warm

explain.say: Arctic foxes change their coat colour. It turns white in winter, to hide in the snow.
These animals use fat, fur and feathers to stay warm.

faq.q: Do polar bears have fur that is white?
faq.a: Their fur can look white, but it is actually clear and translucent. It reflects the light to look white.
asks: Is polar bear fur really white?
What color is a polar bear's fur?

faq.q: How do penguins keep their bodies warm in the cold water?
faq.a: They have a layer of fat and special feathers that help them stay warm while swimming. Their feathers trap air.
asks: Do penguins get cold in the ocean?
What keeps penguins warm when swimming?

faq.q: Do all animals in the Arctic look white?
faq.a: No. Arctic foxes change colour with the seasons to match their surroundings. This is called camouflage.
asks: How do animals hide in the snow?

faq.q: What is blubber and why do animals need it?
faq.a: Blubber is a thick layer of fat under the skin. It keeps the animal warm in icy water.
asks: What is the fat layer under a seal?
Why do animals have thick fat?

faq.q: Do seals have fur like bears?
faq.a: Seals have short fur and a thick layer of blubber. The blubber keeps them warm in icy water.

facts: Polar bears use blubber for insulation against the cold.
Penguins use their wings like flippers to swim.
Arctic foxes change their coat color for camouflage.
The cold environment requires thick layers for survival.

quiz.why: Polar bears live in the Arctic, near the North Pole.

wrong.0: A desert is hot and dry, and polar bears need ice and snow.
wrong.2: A rainforest is warm and wet, and polar bears need the cold.

quiz.say: How does an Arctic fox hide in the snow?

options.show: it stays very still all winter
options.say: it stays very still all winter

quiz.why: In winter its coat turns white. Then it matches the snow.

wrong.0: Blubber keeps seals warm, and it is hidden under the skin.
wrong.1: Foxes move about all winter to find food.

quiz.say: How do penguins move fast in the sea?

options.show: they flap their wings like flippers
options.say: they flap their wings like flippers

quiz.why: A penguin's wings work like flippers. They push the penguin through the water.

wrong.1: Penguins steer with their feet, and their wings push them along.
wrong.2: Fish swish their tails, and penguins push with their wings.
